source.label: FY2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 Employees
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we had a total of 1,539 employees, of whom 448 were based in the United States and 1,091 were based internationally.

payroll.label: total compensation for our median employee in 2025

source.label: 2026 annual-meeting proxy statement (DEF 14A), CEO Pay Ratio
source.quote: The total compensation for our median employee in 2025, as determined under Item 402 of Regulation S-K, was $82,083.

notes: Employees: total head count at December 31, 2025 (448 U.S., 1,091 international). Payroll: the 10-K discloses no total staff cost, so the CEO pay ratio median for 2025 from the April 2026 annual-meeting proxy is used (CEO Phong Q. Le, ratio 168 to 1); the median employee was picked from all 1,539 workers employed at December 31, 2025, with foreign pay converted at fixed internal rates.
